title: TruAge® Age-Verification Solution integrated across NCR Voyix Point-of-Sale Portfolio for Convenience and Fuel Retailers
summary: NCR Voyix RPOS customers can deploy the certified solution through an API integration from Cullinan Group, while the new Voyix POS for CFR solution includes native support for TruAge.
body_markdown:
*Integration delivers instantaneous age assurance at checkout to reduce customer friction and support responsible sales practices*


‍


**ALEXANDRIA, VA. and ATLANTA, GA.** — \[October 6\] — NCR Voyix, a platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining, and NACS, the global association representing convenience and fuel retailers, today announced the integration of the TruAge® digital age-verification solution with NCR Voyix point-of-sale (POS) technology in the United States. NCR Voyix RPOS customers can deploy the certified solution through an API integration from Cullinan Group, while the new[Voyix POS for CFR](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/industry/retail/convenience-fuel) solution includes native support for TruAge.


‍


TruAge allows retailers to verify age, identify fake or expired IDs and check purchase limits by scanning a physical or digital driver’s license. The solution uses secure, anonymized tokens to confirm eligibility without storing unnecessary personal information, helping retailers strengthen compliance without adding steps for store associates.


“TruAge was built by the industry because the industry believed age assurance was too important to leave to chance—or outside commercial interests. Expanding the TruAge ecosystem through industry-leading technology providers is critical to making digital age verification more accessible for retailers,” said Stephanie Sikorski, CEO of TruAge and vice president of strategic initiatives for NACS. “The NCR Voyix integration significantly broadens the availability of TruAge to convenience and fuel retailing. With NCR Voyix joining other industry-leading technology providers, approximately 75% of the convenience marketplace can now access TruAge through their existing point-of-sale technology. That scale is an important step toward making responsible retailing easier, more consistent and built directly into the way retailers already operate and consumers transact.”


“NCR Voyix fuel and convenience retail customers continue to value solutions that strengthen compliance while preserving the fast and convenient experience for consumers on the move,” said Nick East, Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer at NCR Voyix. “The integration of TruAge with our point-of-sale applications helps retailers drive efficient operations while enabling responsible sales practices.”


> “Responsible retailing must evolve in an increasingly digital and policy-driven marketplace,” said Frank Gleeson, president and CEO of NACS. “The NCR Voyix integration expands retailer access to TruAge and helps create the consistency, scale and interoperability needed for age assurance to work across the marketplace. This industry-led collaboration strengthens responsible retailing, prevents underage access and ensures convenience retailers help shape the future of age assurance.”


TruAge integration with NCR Voyix RPOS is available through Cullinan Group.


> “This certified integration makes TruAge available to more than 20,000 stores with NCR Voyix RPOS today,” said Craig Panter, CEO of Cullinan Group. “Working with TruAge and NCR Voyix, we are giving retailers a simpler way to modernize age verification at checkout.”


‍


**See TruAge at the NACS Show:**


NCR Voyix will demonstrate the TruAge integration with Voyix POS for CFR at booth #C6522 during the 2026 NACS Show, October 6 through 9 in Las Vegas. The RPOS integration will also be demonstrated at the NACS Future of Convenience booth #C400. Retailers can book a live demo and meet one-on-one with the TruAge team[onsite](https://bookings.cloud.microsoft/book/TruAgeTeamatNACSShow@convenience.org/?ismsaljsauthenabled) .


‍


**About TruAge:**


TruAge® is a not-for-profit, universally accepted, digital age-verification solution developed by NACS and Conexxus — in long-term partnership with leading retailers and manufacturers across industries. TruAge helps retailers accurately verify a customer's eligibility to purchase age-restricted products using secure, one-time-use tokens that protect consumer privacy, reduce the risk of underage sales and enable frictionless commerce. For more information and to schedule a demo, visit[mytruage.org](https://mytruage.org/) .


‍


**About NACS:**


For 65 years, NACS has been recognized as the premier association for convenience and fuel retailers. NACS has more than 1,000 retail member companies that cumulatively represent more than 400,000 stores in 50-plus countries, including 45,000 stores in the United States. The U.S. convenience store industry, with nearly 152,000 stores nationwide selling fuel, food, and merchandise, conducts 160 million transactions daily and had sales of $818 billion in 2025. For more information, visit[convenience.org](https://convenience.org/) . Follow NACS on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nacs/) ,[Twitter](https://twitter.com/NACSonline) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/nacsonline) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nacs_online/) .


‍


**About NCR Voyix**


NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. For more information, visit[ncrvoyix.com](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/) .


‍


**About Cullinan Group**


Cullinan Group is a retail technology firm focused on simplifying how convenience retailers introduce new digital products and services. Its team brings deep experience from HP, IBM, Verifone, NCR Voyix and the technology business behind Afterpay. Cullinan’s flexible integration platform connects existing point-of-sale systems to new capabilities without requiring major IT modification, helping retailers innovate faster while preserving the systems they already trust.
